# CustomDancePlayer v0.2.2

下载带 With-BepInEx 的整合包，退出游戏后解压到 MateEngineX.exe 同级。从 0.1.x 升级时，再运行 Run-OldVersionMigration.cmd。已有兼容 BepInEx 安装可使用插件包更新。

[使用说明](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.2/README_zh.md) · [安装与迁移](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.2/docs/user/INSTALL_0.2.md)


- 舞蹈开始时清除角色残留的闭眼、口型等表情，避免和舞蹈表情叠加。停止后交还表情控制。
- 修复 VMD 镜头曲线控制点的读取顺序，减少 404 等密集运镜的位移顿挫。已有舞蹈包可直接播放。
- 移除「保持 VMD 角色直立」，保留原动作的俯仰和侧倾。「固定朝向」仍可独立开启。

---

## English

For a first installation, download the With-BepInEx archive, exit the game, and extract everything beside MateEngineX.exe. When upgrading from 0.1.x, run Run-OldVersionMigration.cmd before starting the game. Use the smaller plugin archive to update an existing compatible BepInEx installation.

[User guide](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.2/README.md) · [Installation and migration](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.2/docs/user/INSTALL_0.2.md)


- Clear lingering avatar expressions, such as a blink or lip shape, before the dance starts. Restore the host's expression state when playback stops.
- Read VMD camera curve control points in the correct order to reduce stutter in densely keyed camera moves such as 404. Existing dance packages work as-is.
- Remove the keep-upright option so VMD motions retain authored pitch and roll. Facing lock remains available.
